visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a dark blue denim shirt and a white undershirt, stands in a kitchen. He holds a plate of sliced watermelon. Beside him is a tall glass filled with yellow shaved ice topped with golden syrup. Large red and white captions appear at the top. (2) Close-up shot of a spoon scooping into a red shaved ice dessert inside a pink-tinted glass on a wooden surface. (3) Gloved hands use a metal grater to shave a block of frozen watermelon into a glass. Fine red ice flakes accumulate, creating a mound. (4) A hand pours condensed milk from a blue and white Nestle bottle onto the peak of the red watermelon ice. (5) The man takes a bite of the red dessert, exhibiting a wide-eyed, pleasantly surprised facial expression. He gestures with his free hand while speaking. (6) The man holds two large peaches in front of the camera, then switches to grating a frozen peach. Yellowish flakes pile up in the glass. (7) The man eats the peach shaved ice, comparing the flavors. He points to the dessert while explaining the texture. (8) He continues eating and talking, ending with a humorous warning about using bananas, showing a laughing facial expression.

(7) [Subtitle]: 淋上煉乳. (8) [Subtitle]: 有模有樣 一滴水都沒加的刨冰. (9) [Subtitle]: 很好吃欸. (10) [Subtitle]: 它的水份含量就是果汁. (11) [Subtitle]: 冰沙感不會很銳利. (12) [Subtitle]: 反而很快換成清涼 溫度很低的. (13) [Subtitle]: 西瓜汁. (14) [Subtitle]: 國外也流行 拿水蜜桃做刨冰. (15) [Subtitle]: 冷凍水蜜桃刨成雪花冰. (16) [Subtitle]: 居然可以. (17) [Subtitle]: 太多了老闆. (18) [Subtitle]: 淋上煉乳. (19) [Subtitle]: 也滿好吃的 就比較優雅一點. (20) [Subtitle]: 西瓜果香氣比較旺盛.
